long_biography.plain_text:
The Qatar Olympic Committee was established in 1979 with Abdullah as its first president. He led the organisation through its formative years, helping establish Qatar's early Olympic administration. That role began while he was serving in the armed forces and preceded his progression into the interior ministry and the premiership.

Private investment sat alongside his advisory role to the emir. An investment company he indirectly owned accumulated a 9.5 per cent interest in industrial biotechnology group Amyris, where he became a director. He also chaired two Qatari investment businesses, bringing experience in project development and finance to the company board.
